title: Let the life match the line
summary: Let truth grow visible in the way the body moves through the day. Let this stay near the next choice: hold onto this: the truest religion is clean conduct sustained by Naam.
takeaway: Let conduct answer before performance does.
lifeApplication: Before speaking about values again, ask what your treatment of people showed today and choose the cleaner act.

source.shortMeaning: The heart becomes a holy place through clean conduct and Naam.
source.lifeApplication: Before speaking devotion again, clean one concrete act: the message, the errand, the debt, or the tone.
